Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed so your security and engineering teams have what they need to scope the integration:

- Use case: SCIM provisioning for user onboarding + SAML SSO for auth (SP-initiated primary).
- Expected user count at launch: ~1k active users, growing to ~5k in 12 months.
- RBAC: you asked about admin role granularity and audit logs.

Requests / next steps
1) SOC 2: I've attached our SOC 2 Type II summary (redwood-soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf). If your team wants the full report we can start an NDA and DocuSign.
2) SSO / SAML details: we support SAML 2.0 (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated). Please let us know which IdP you plan to use (Okta, Azure AD, Ping, etc.) and whether you require SP metadata.
3) SCIM provisioning: we support SCIM 2.0 (User and Group provisioning). If you can share the list of attributes you require (e.g. userName, name, emails, active, groups, custom attributes) we can confirm support or propose a mapping.
4) RBAC & admin controls: we'll share a short doc showing default roles (Superadmin, Admin, Developer, Read-only) and whether you need custom roles.
5) Vendor security questionnaire: if you prefer, we can start the questionnaire here: https://na1.redwood-inference.com/security/vendor-questionnaire/CE-98765. Alternately we can take a PDF and return answers.

Attachments included here: redwood-soc2-type2-summary-2026.pdf, redwood-saml-scim-overview.pdf

Hi Alex —

Quick technical answers to the SCIM / SAML questions: 

SSO / SAML
- Protocol: SAML 2.0, supports both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows.
- Metadata: we can provide SP metadata XML; Okta works out-of-the-box with metadata upload.
- Assertion attributes: we typically consume NameID (email) and optional attributes for groups if you prefer group-based assertions.

SCIM provisioning
- Protocol: SCIM 2.0 (RFC7643/7644).
- Supported resources: Users and Groups.
- Attributes we support by default: userName, externalId, name.familyName, name.givenName, displayName, emails[type=work], active, meta, groups (group membership via group members).
- Group push: Yes — we support group push from Okta and group membership sync.
- Custom attributes: supported via attribute mapping; we can accept custom extension attributes on a case-by-case basis.

RBAC / admin controls
- Default roles: Superadmin (full account + billing + config), Admin (configuration and user management), Developer (API keys and app configuration), Read-only (view-only).
- Custom roles: supported via role templates; can limit API scopes.
- Audit logs: admin actions, user provisioning events, and API key activity are logged and retained for 365 days in our console; we can export logs on request.

Provisioning tokens & security
- SCIM uses bearer tokens with rotational secrets. We recommend using Okta-managed SCIM app credentials and rotating tokens on a 90-day cadence.

If you want, we can run a short Okta test into a staging tenant (we can provide a temporary staging org) — that usually takes 30–60 mins to validate mapping for a small user sample.

Let me know what attributes you need beyond the default list and if you'd like us to spin up a staging tenant this week.

Cheers,
